prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE four-option game concept comparison board, not a production sprite sheet.
Input image 1 is the user's current game screenshot: reference for the strange protruding door we are replacing and the exact map camera. Input image 2 is a clean full view of the same implemented kiosk: reference for its overall architecture, green metal roof, original front sales counter, cream/green palette and painterly game rendering.

Create a polished landscape concept board with FOUR equally large panels in a 2-by-2 layout. Header in Chinese "小卖铺 · 侧入口样式对比". Each panel shows the SAME kiosk from the SAME nearly overhead, axis-aligned 2.5D orthographic GAME CAMERA as the references. Keep north up and the side entrance on the WEST/LEFT exterior wall. Show the west entry clearly and the original south-facing sales window, single counter and single blue-clad vendor in each panel. Crop neighboring buildings and omit all HUD/control overlays. A small orange-clad player standing a short distance LEFT of the threshold provides consistent human scale. Preserve modest, utilitarian, slightly worn factory-campus architecture. The entrance is ONE person wide, recessed into the wall, not a new vestibule or freestanding door structure.

Change ONLY the side entrance treatment in the four panels:
A, upper left: label "A · 贴墙推拉门". Slim muted green sheet-metal SLIDING door parked NORTH along the exterior west wall on a discreet track. Door panel runs parallel to the vertical west wall, flush to it, no leaf projecting into the walkway. An unobstructed dark recessed side-wall opening, thin cream jamb, flat threshold with the same existing ground material. Compact small "入口" plate and practical lamp. The panel must look integrated with the west wall.
B, upper right: label "B · 上卷卷帘门". Compact gray-green roll-up shutter fully lifted into a shallow header INSIDE the west wall. Thin guide rails, clear recessed opening with subtle glimpse of stocked shelf inside. No swinging leaf or entrance porch. A tiny utilitarian lamp and "入口" plate.
C, lower left: label "C · 内开半玻璃门". Narrow green steel-framed door with one frosted-glass upper pane. Door opens INWARD into the kiosk and stays mostly within the interior silhouette. Outside walkway completely clear; dark doorway recess visible. Thin jambs, small lamp, modest flush threshold, restrained glass reflection. No giant frontal door leaf or outward opening.
D, lower right: label "D · 敞开式门洞". Open doorless recessed entry in cream plaster with green steel edging, a very shallow small rain hood, simple wall lamp and "入口" plate. Clear continuous existing gray ground leads into the kiosk; glimpse of shelf in the dark interior. No curtain, no door leaf, no railing or barrier.

CRITICAL perspective: these are entrances in a VERTICAL LEFT SIDE WALL, with clear connection through that wall into the kiosk; never a SOUTH/front-facing rectangular doorway pasted next to the kiosk. Do NOT reuse the original awkward big outward-swinging leaf. Door frames integrate with the side-wall returns. Every opening has visibly continuous walkable ground across the threshold, believable scale, no stairs. Roof stays on in every panel; just a small local opening/recess reveals entry. Keep the original front awning/sign "小卖铺", honey-brown counter, product shelves and single vendor consistent in all panels. No extra indoor counter or second vendor.
Style: detailed hand-painted raster game concept, subdued sage green, cream gray, aged wood; crisp readable edges, soft overhead daytime light, matching original screenshot. Avoid photorealism, exaggerated perspective, diagonal isometric buildings, unrelated neon or modern mall finishes. Neutral parchment margins, clean readable Chinese labels, no annotations overlapping doors, no arrows or large text covering entrances, no watermark. Fill panels with useful close views so all four doorway treatments are easy to compare.
scope: Preview concepts only; no game assets or map changed.
